white_beans.notes: Generic French white bean; close to canned/drained white-bean corpus form but not specifically cannellini.

kidney_beans.notes: Matches canned/drained kidney-bean form; colour variety is less specific than USDA mapping.

avocado.description: Avocado, flesh without skin, pitted, raw
avocado.notes: Generic avocado rather than USDA Hass-specific mapping.

banana.notes: Raw edible flesh; species group Musa spp.

tuna.notes: Drained canned tuna form; brine differs from USDA canned-in-water mapping.

almonds.description: Almond, with peel, no added salt
almonds.notes: Whole skin-on unsalted almond; Ciqual label does not explicitly say raw.

walnuts.notes: Edible walnut kernel; dried form differs from USDA raw-halves wording.

pumpkin_seeds.notes: Dried seed rather than USDA raw pepita-specific form.

sunflower_seeds.notes: Generic seed record; processing state is underspecified.

broccoli.notes: Raw Brassica oleracea var. italica match.

eggs.notes: Generic raw whole egg; USDA mapping is Grade-A large whole raw.

onion.notes: European generic raw onion average; USDA canonical mapping currently uses yellow onion with explicit qualification.

mushroom.description: Button mushroom or cultivated mushroom, raw
mushroom.notes: Agaricus bisporus; aligns with USDA white-button mapping.

rice.notes: Generic raw white rice; USDA mapping is raw long-grain white rice.

canned_tomato.notes: European canned tomato flesh; differs from USDA crushed-canned mapping.

salmon.notes: Salmo salar farmed raw; strong European form match not promoted in the bounded USDA lane.

milk.notes: French average semi-skimmed milk; canonical app milk is less form-specific.

apple.notes: Generic raw apple with skin; avoids cultivar-specific selection.

mango.description: Mango, flesh without skin, pitted, raw
